correctness.rationale: For arbitrary m>=3,t>=3,s_i>=t, the exact clique constraints give X=A union (c*B), where A=join_i L_i(t-1), B=join_i L_i(t-2). The simplex skeleton L_i(r) is a wedge of C(s_i-2,r) copies of S^(r-1), with integral cycles wedge^r ker(sum:Z^{P_i}->Z). Hence dim(B)=m(t-2)-1 is below the connectivity dimension of A when noncontractible; A is contractible in the full-simplex boundary case, so B->A is always null. Mapping cone A vee Sigma B gives the two sphere dimensions/ranks and torsion-freeness without finite extrapolation. The two homology degrees are separated by m-1, so the cofiber exact sequence and signed join chains give canonical integral modules and the (-1)^r petal-swap sign. Independently enumerated a three K4, t=3 instance: 407 faces including empty and mod-two Betti_3=8, Betti_5=1. Exact Git blob paths and all public scientific files inspected; finite test only corroborates.
